code: export const load=(key,fallback)=>{try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(key);return raw?JSON.parse(raw):fallback;}catch(e){console.error('load error',e);return fallback;}};export const save=(key,value)=>{try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(value));}catch(e){console.error('save error',e);}};export const remove=key=>{try{localStorage.removeItem(key);}catch(e){console.error(e);}};
